agent_discovery.description: Identify and locate one visible requested item in 3D, metric, depth, world, camera, or robot coordinates using synchronized RGB-D evidence. This is the mandatory Skill whenever a request combines object identification with 3D location; do not substitute the RGB-only analyze_visual_scene tool. It returns a metric workpiece point when depth is trustworthy, a task-plane intersection when supplied, or explicit bearing-only evidence with an active-perception recommendation. A successful metric result publishes a short-lived Fabric workpiece assertion for the HOT scene compiler; it never moves the robot or treats reflective/transparent background depth as item geometry.
when_to_use: An Agent or Skill needs a metric item point before planning a no-contact approach.
The user asks to identify an object and locate it in 3D, metric, depth, world-frame, camera-frame, or robot-frame coordinates.
A visible reflective or transparent target needs a non-error-only degraded fallback.
A fixed-altitude request can supply a task plane for ray-plane intersection.
when_not_to_use: The target item is not visible or is ambiguous.
A full six-degree-of-freedom CAD object pose is required.
The result would be treated as motion authorization without a separate controller preview.
side_effects: Reads one synchronized RGB-D frame and one timestamped transform.
Calls the configured VLM once and may write a diagnostic evidence image.
A metric result publishes or refreshes a short-lived WORKPIECE assertion in Fabric; publication failure is reported without discarding the location.
Does not stage, authorize, or execute motion.

question.description: Complete description of the one visible item to locate.

target_frame.description: Frame in which metric point or bearing evidence is returned. Use CURRENT_WORLD for the live VIO world frame without locating the arm base; use rebot_arm_base only when an active world-to-arm relationship is actually required.
